## Design

### 2026-10-27: Almost 3 hour grind session here's what I did:

**2.85h**

Almost 3 hour grind session here's what I did:

Off screen, I researched a bit about the stuff in the guide and some good ideas. Took about 30 minutes. On lapse, I made my project in KiCad and completed my schematics! Originally I was going to go with a different microcontroller -- XIAO-RP2040-SMD, but it was really unfamiliar to me and it seemed unnecessarily large. Plus, it turns out I didn't have a corresponding footprint??? So I went with something classic that I use all the time:

XIAO-ESP32-S3

Wow I didn't even need to search the name up!! :DD
Well yeah, other than that smooth sailing. It was so weird, because week 4 of Halflife is so autonomous I had to search up A LOT to make sure I was doing this right ahaha.

I got started on my PCB! Right now I think I'll get ready to add a lott of art.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/7f0c9c71-8014-45cf-972e-90833f27f148/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-28: Last session I finished the schematics aaand...

**2.23h**

Last session I finished the schematics aaand...

I low-key finished routing and making the outline in like 5 minutes :p

That's when I realized -- my design was wayyyy too simple. This wouldn't be enough to cover my time for the week, + I skipped week 2... ha... ha, so I have 7.15 hrs to go. And here I was thinking I'd work more so I could get better funding.

So I added a buzzer for sound effects, I upgraded the display per the guide (which I actually haven't been following that much, I've been free-handing this a lot-- maybe too much :) which is GOOD since I'm a beginner and I'm taking intiative >:D), I added an on/off button (slider), and made it portable per the LiPo battery connector. This is probably the most I'm going to work in a couple of days. Honestly I'm worried, this design is coming along a bit too easily, so I think I'm going to tweak things up a bit for the code. So far so good honestly, I'm just nervous haha, my other two designs still haven't gotten approved. Even week 1 : (
